entities.name: Bence Máté
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Bence Máté is a Hungarian wildlife photographer. He pioneered the one-way glass photography technique now popular among hide-based nature photographers around the world. In 2010, his image 'Marvel of Ants' won the Wildlife Photographer of the Year grand title.
